AI Page Builder

Describe it — AI builds the page for you

No blank-page stress. Tell the AI what your page is about and it drafts the headline, description, button, theme colour and feature cards — straight into the builder, ready for you to fine-tune, add ads and publish.

  1. 1Describe your page — what it sells or offers, who it is for, and what the button should do.
  2. 2AI drafts it in the builder — text, colour and five feature cards, applied to the live preview.
  3. 3Fine-tune & publish — change anything, add ad codes in the Ads tab, then publish on this domain.
Headline & text written for youColour & features includedEverything stays editableFree to try

AI runs through this site's own secure server proxy — no key is ever asked from you. You can also ask AI to edit a page you already made: open the builder, go to the AI tab, and describe the change. If AI is not switched on for this site yet, the builder shows the setup guidance instead.

Chapter — 0:08

Choose a template

Open the Templates page, filter by category (marketing, portfolio, job, shop, business) or search, then press Use Template. Or start from a completely Blank Page and build block by block.

Chapter — 0:14

Customise text, colour & fonts

In the Design tab pick a preset, font and theme colour — or set any custom colour, a headline colour, a body-text colour and separate fonts for the headline and the text. Every word is editable in the Content tab or by clicking it in the preview.

Chapter — 0:14

Add ads from any network

Create an ad unit in your network dashboard first (Adsterra, Google AdSense, PropellerAds, Monetag or any other), then in the Ads tab pick the network and the unit for each slot — popunder, top banner, in-content, native, social bar, sticky footer — and paste its full code. Ads run on your published live page.

Full walkthrough — 0:00

Build & edit with AI

Use the AI panel on the home page or the AI tab in the builder: describe the page you want and AI drafts the headline, text, button, colour and feature cards into the preview. Already have a page? Give AI an edit instruction instead — for example, make the headline shorter.

Chapter — 0:14

Design desktop & mobile separately

Switch the preview between Desktop and Mobile and set each version's layout, headline size, spacing and feature columns separately. Visitors automatically see the design made for their device. On a phone, turn on Desktop Mode to use the builder.

Chapter — 0:25

Publish & host it live

In the Publish tab, choose your page address and press Publish — your page goes live on this PageCraft domain at /p/your-page, ready to open in any browser and share. Manage it any time from My Pages: View Live, Edit or Unpublish.

Separate device design

Desktop and mobile are designed separately. Switch the preview device (top-right of the preview) and adjust each version — visitors automatically see the design made for their device.

Build your page block by block — this is how a Blank Page is made. Blocks appear below your hero section in order. You can also click a block in the preview to edit it.

Not just Adsterra — paste ad codes from any network: Adsterra, Google AdSense, PropellerAds, Monetag or any other. Pick the network for each slot, paste its code exactly as the network gives it, and it runs in that slot on your live page.

How to set up ads correctly — 4 steps

  1. Create the ad unit in your network dashboard first (Adsterra: Websites → your site → Add Ad Unit. AdSense: Ads → By ad unit. PropellerAds / Monetag: Sites → Zones).
  2. Match the format to the right slot below — use the slot map. A code in the wrong slot will not show properly.
  3. Copy the FULL code — every <script> tag, exactly as given. Do not shorten it, do not paste only a link.
  4. Publish, then open the live page to test. Real ads never load inside the builder preview — that protects your account from invalid self-impressions. They load on the published live page.
Popunder / PopAdsterra Popunder · PropellerAds OnClick · Monetag OnClick
Top BannerAdsterra Banner 728×90 or 320×50 · AdSense Display unit
In-Content BannerAdsterra Banner 300×250 / 728×90 · AdSense In-article
Native AdsAdsterra Native Banner · Monetag Native · AdSense Multiplex
Social BarAdsterra Social Bar · PropellerAds In-Page Push · Monetag Push
Sticky FooterAdsterra Banner 320×50 · AdSense Anchor-style unit

One network code per slot. Never paste the same code into two slots, and never click your own ads. New Adsterra / AdSense units can take 5–30 minutes to start filling after the first live view.
